question: Does a deterministic option-confidence profile (one Qwen2.5-7B forward, no sampling) carry routing signal that query-only lacks?

probe.prompt: raw panel query + frozen suffix Answer:
probe.readout: softmax over next-token logits of the 10 option-letter tokens A-J at the suffix position
probe.determinism: greedy forward, temperature-free, single pass, no generation
probe.consistency_feature: top-1 option equals the majority parsed option of the medium 5 sampled repeats (no ground truth)

arms_detail.A_query: GTE embedding only; must reproduce E6 A choices exactly
arms_detail.B_logit_stats: query + top-1 one-hot(10) + top-1 prob + top-2 margin + entropy + prob variance + majority-exists + top1-equals-majority (3584+16)

target: mean5 quality difference vs R1 (identical to E6 A); Ridge alpha=1 three delta heads, R1 score 0, first-max tie order
evaluation: outer-test mean5 EQ, identical scale to the 73.50% anchor

bootstrap.bonferroni: 97.5% intervals for B/C vs A reported as context

success: EQ>73.50% AND paired query bootstrap CI95 lower>0 vs A; AUC-style metrics are diagnostics only

branches.on_pass: final method candidate: Query Representation + Model Confidence Profile router
branches.on_fail: one small-scale E9b pilot (cheap partial response + verifier/confidence); if that fails, stop signal search and re-scope the thesis

inference_limits: Probe distribution is measured on the raw prompt without CoT; a CoT-conditioned distribution may differ.
Consistency feature uses the five historical medium repeats (deployment would use fresh samples).
constraints: No ground truth in any feature
